title: Factors Affecting Reaction Rate
body:
Zinc granules react with dilute hydrochloric acid according to the equation:

Zn(s) + 2HCl(aq) --> ZnCl$$_2$$(aq) + H$$_2$$(g)

Explain how each of the following changes would affect the rate of the reaction:
(a) Using zinc powder instead of zinc granules
(b) Increasing the concentration of HCl
